_comment_temp: 'CPU Package' is the on-die DTS - the standard CPU temperature, and what HWMonitor calls Package. It is spiky. 'Core Average' is smoother; the ITE 'Temperature #N' sensors are board probes and are what Gigabyte Control Center shows.
_comment_fan: Fan #1 = CPU header (GCC 'CPU'), #2/#3 = System 1 and 2 (empty), #4 = System 3, #5 = CPU_OPT which on this build is the PUMP.
_comment_fun: Fun mode alternates second by second: real, joke, real, next joke. Toggle from the tray icon. Each frame is [big, small]; null keeps the REAL reading for that slot, and the defaults never fake the temperature. NOTE 8088 is deliberate: the panel offsets the last two digits of a ~8000-range fan value by +20, so sending 8088 displays 8008. Values under about 1020 display verbatim, which is why 420 is sent as-is. See fan_map.txt and FINDINGS.md.
_comment_fan_low2_offset: Correction for the fan slot's digit offset. Currently OFF (null) because the +20 pattern measured around 8000 does NOT hold below 1000: 4 displays as 4 and 420 as 420. Run fan_map.py to map the real behaviour across the range.
